# What is the top-selling video game franchise of all time?
Minecraft
Mario
Grand Theft Auto
Pokémon
**Choose wisely!** The correct answer, the explanation, and an intriguing story await.
Correct Answer: Mario
[Try the Next Trivia > What did the ESP button do on portable CD players?](https://www.techspot.com/trivia/5-what-did-esp-button-do-portable-cd-players/)

## A little background
Mario's first appearance came with the original Donkey Kong in 1981, since then the Mario franchise has sold over 879 million copies, with "Super Mario" titles making up 430 million of that.
Other major selling games that are considered part of the Mario franchise include the Mario Kart series (181 million copies), Mario Party (69 million), and Mario Sports (46 million).
Not listed in the possible answers, but Tetris is the second best-selling game franchise with roughly 495 million sales, courtesy of its popularity as a download among mobile phone owners.

## 11. FIFA
Things aren’t slowing down either, as sales of the latest game, EA Sports’ _FIFA 18_ , have already surpassed the 10 million mark, making it the most successful soccer game of all time.

## 5. Wii (Series)
_Wii Sports_ is one of the highest-selling video games of all time, leading to several sequels and spin-offs as Nintendo tried to capitalize on its massive success. Motion controls and multiplayer action were the main focus of design for this franchise and gamers of all ages jumped in on the fad.

...

## 2. Pokémon
_Pokémon_ video games have been popular for more than 30 years and have sold over 300 million units in that timespan making it the second most popular gaming franchise in history.

...

## 1. Mario
The _Mario_ franchise consists of series such as _Super Mario_ , M _ario Kart_ , and the _Mario Sports_ titles (just to name a few), all of which have sold very well. Mario has, in fact, appeared in five of the top fifteen best-selling games of all time.
The Mario character has appeared in movies and television shows, as well as toys, clothing, and even cereal. The franchise has sold 529 million games in its storied history and with several games featuring the character being released each year that number will break the 600 million mark in no time.

Mario Mario sits atop a gaming empire. The combined sales of all of Nintendo's _Mario_ series games and spin-offs have now reached at least 893.4 million units, as of 10 June 2025, with 15.5 million contributed by 2023's _Super Mario Bros. Wonder_ .
